name: Bloodfields: Command
summary: The strategic command center of the Bloodfields warfront, where Muramite officers direct operations.
description: Bloodfields Command is the nerve‑center of Muramite operations. Command tents, tactical platforms, interrogation chambers, and Discord‑warped command nodes dominate the area. Officers coordinate assaults, manage supply lines, and oversee legion deployments. Resistance infiltrators attempt sabotage, intelligence theft, and prisoner extraction. Discord energy occasionally destabilizes command nodes, creating dangerous arcane surges.
